Note :

  1. All results should be interpreted in relation to the individual case history.
  2. Food intolerance is an IgG mediated reaction unlike food allergy which is IgE mediated.
  3. This assay does not test any intolerance arising due to enzyme deficiency or chemical sensitivity.
  4. Some individuals may show positivity for many food items, which could be due to local gut pathology. It is recommended to consult your physicianInterpretation
